name: inventory-management-backend
description: Sistema de Gestión de Inventario - Backend Microservicios

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:gateway
scripts.install:services: cd services && for /d %%i in (*) do (cd %%i && npm install && cd ..)
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:users" "npm run dev:products" "npm run dev:categories" "npm run dev:inventory" "npm run dev:purchases" "npm run dev:sales" "npm run dev:reports" "npm run dev:invoices" "npm run dev:cart" "npm run dev:checkout" "npm run dev:ecommerce" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:email" "npm run dev:whatsapp" "npm run dev:notifications" "npm run dev:audit" "npm run dev:config"
